value.text: Research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions: reinvent productivity and business processes; build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform; create more personal computing.

strategic_priorities.quote:
To achieve our vision, our research and development efforts focus on three interconnected ambitions:
•
Reinvent productivity and business processes.
•
Build the intelligent cloud and intelligent edge platform.
•
Create more personal computing.

value.text: Growth depends on securely delivering continuous innovation and advancing our leading productivity and collaboration tools and services, including Office, Dynamics, and LinkedIn.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our growth depends on securely delivering continuous innovation and advancing our leading productivity and collaboration tools and services, including Office, Dynamics, and LinkedIn.

value.text: Partnering with organizations on their digital transformation is one of our largest opportunities; we aim to become the strategic digital transformation platform and partner of choice.

strategic_priorities.quote: Partnering with organizations on their digital transformation during this period is one of our largest opportunities and we are uniquely positioned to become the strategic digital transformation platform and partner of choice; their success is our success.

value.text: Our strategy requires continued investment in datacenters and other hybrid and edge infrastructure to support our services.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our strategy requires continued investment in datacenters and other hybrid and edge infrastructure to support our services.

value.text: Accelerating our innovation across the spectrum of intelligent edge devices, from IoT sensors to gateway devices and edge hardware.

strategic_priorities.quote: We see more emerging use cases and needs for compute and security at the edge and are accelerating our innovation across the spectrum of intelligent edge devices, from IoT sensors to gateway devices and edge hardware to build, manage, and secure edge workloads.

value.text: Acquiring Nuance Communications to build on our industry-specific cloud offerings.

strategic_priorities.quote: In April 2021, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Nuance Communications, Inc., a cloud and AI software provider with healthcare and enterprise AI experience. The acquisition will build on our industry-specific cloud offerings.

value.text: Accelerating development of mixed reality solutions with new Azure services and devices, merging the physical and digital worlds.

strategic_priorities.quote: We are accelerating our development of mixed reality solutions with new Azure services and devices. Microsoft Mesh enables presence and shared experiences from anywhere through mixed reality applications.

value.text: Accelerating adoption of AI innovations from research to products; the ability to convert data into AI drives our competitive advantage.

strategic_priorities.quote: The ability to convert data into AI drives our competitive advantage.

value.text: Committed to designing and marketing first-party devices to help drive innovation, create new device categories, and stimulate demand in the Windows ecosystem.

strategic_priorities.quote: We are committed to designing and marketing first-party devices to help drive innovation, create new device categories, and stimulate demand in the Windows ecosystem.

value.text: Continuing to invest in content, community, and cloud services to expand usage and deepen engagement in gaming, including cloud gaming across PC, console, and mobile.

strategic_priorities.quote: To expand usage and deepen engagement, we continue to invest in content, community, and cloud services as we pursue the expansive opportunity in the gaming industry. We have broadened our approach to how we think about gaming end-to-end, from the way games are created and distributed to how they are played, including cloud gaming so players can stream across PC, console, and mobile.

value.text: Windows 10 monetization ambition includes gaming, services, subscriptions, and search advertising.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our ambition for Windows 10 monetization opportunities includes gaming, services, subscriptions, and search advertising.

value.text: Goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long-term, investing significant resources in transforming the workplace; cloud-based services; applying AI; using Windows to fuel the cloud business; security end-to-end; and inventing new gaming experiences.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our goal is to lead the industry in several distinct areas of technology over the long-term, which we expect will translate to sustained growth. We are investing significant resources in:

value.text: Future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions.

strategic_priorities.quote: Our future growth depends on our ability to transcend current product category definitions, business models, and sales motions.

value.text: Commitment to be carbon negative by 2030 and remove all historically emitted carbon by 2050, with $1 billion over four years in climate technologies, plus water positive and zero waste by 2030.

strategic_priorities.quote: In January 2020, we announced a bold commitment and detailed plan to be carbon negative by 2030, and to remove from the environment by 2050 all the carbon we have emitted since our founding in 1975. This included a commitment to invest $1 billion over four years in new technologies and innovative climate solutions. We built on this pledge by adding commitments to be water positive by 2030, zero waste by 2030, and to protect ecosystems by developing a Planetary Computer.

value.text: Doubling the number of Black and African American people managers, senior individual contributors, and senior leaders in the United States by 2025 as part of addressing racial injustice and inequity.

strategic_priorities.quote: These efforts include increasing our representation and strengthening our culture of inclusion by doubling the number of Black and African American people managers, senior individual contributors, and senior leaders in the United States by 2025; evolving our ecosystem with our supply chain, banking partners, and partner ecosystem

value.text: Maintaining long-term commitment to research and development across digital work and life experiences, cloud computing, AI, devices, and operating systems.

strategic_priorities.quote: Based on our assessment of key technology trends, we maintain our long-term commitment to research and development across a wide spectrum of technologies, tools, and platforms spanning digital work and life experiences, cloud computing, AI, devices, and operating systems.

segments.quote: We operate our business and report our financial performance using three segments: Productivity and Business Processes, Intelligent Cloud, and More Personal Computing.
Our Intelligent Cloud segment consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services that can power modern business and developers.
Our More Personal Computing segment consists of products and services that put customers at the center of the experience with our technology.

headcount.quote: As of June 30, 2021, we employed approximately 181,000 people on a full-time basis, 103,000 in the U.S. and 78,000 internationally.

value.description: Completed acquisition of ZeniMax Media Inc., parent of Bethesda Softworks LLC, for $8.1 billion, reported in More Personal Computing segment.

events.quote: On March 9, 2021, we completed our acquisition of ZeniMax Media Inc. (“ZeniMax”), the parent company of Bethesda Softworks LLC, for a total purchase price of $8.1 billion, consisting primarily of cash. The purchase price included $768 million of cash and cash equivalents acquired.

value.description: Definitive agreement to acquire Nuance Communications, Inc. for $56.00 per share, all cash, valued at $19.7 billion, expected to close by end of calendar year 2021.

events.quote: On April 11, 2021, we entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Nuance Communications, Inc. (“Nuance”) for $56.00 per share in an all-cash transaction valued at $19.7 billion, inclusive of Nuance’s net debt. The acquisition has been approved by Nuance’s shareholders, and we expect it to close by the end of calendar year 2021, subject to the satisfaction of certain regulatory approvals and other customary closing conditions.

value.description: Change in accounting estimate: useful life of server equipment increased from three to four years and network equipment from two to four years, effective fiscal year 2021, increasing operating income by $2.7 billion and net income by $2.3 billion.

events.quote: In July 2020, we completed an assessment of the useful lives of our server and network equipment and determined we should increase the estimated useful life of server equipment from three years to four years and increase the estimated useful life of network equipment from two years to four years. This change in accounting estimate was effective beginning fiscal year 2021.

value.description: Debt exchange in March 2021: exchanged a portion of existing debt at a premium for cash and new debt with longer maturities.

events.quote: In March 2021 and June 2020, we exchanged a portion of our existing debt at a premium for cash and new debt with longer maturities to take advantage of favorable financing rates in the debt markets, reflecting our credit rating and the low interest rate environment.

value.description: Settlement of an additional portion of IRS audits for tax years 2004 to 2013 with a payment of $1.7 billion, including tax and interest, in the second quarter of fiscal year 2021.

events.quote: In the second quarter of fiscal year 2021, we settled an additional portion of the IRS audits for tax years 2004 to 2013 and made a payment of $1.7 billion, including tax and interest. We remain under audit for tax years 2004 to 2017.

value.description: Recorded a net income tax benefit of $620 million in Q3 FY2021 following the India Supreme Court decision on withholding taxes on software sales, covering fiscal years 1996 through 2016.

events.quote: Therefore, we recorded a net income tax benefit of $620 million in the third quarter of fiscal year 2021 to reflect the results of the India Supreme Court decision impacting fiscal year 1996 through fiscal year 2016.

value.description: Share repurchases of 101 million shares for $23.0 billion during fiscal year 2021 through share repurchase programs.

events.quote: During fiscal years 2021 and 2020, we repurchased 101 million shares and 126 million shares of our common stock for $23.0 billion and $19.7 billion, respectively, through our share repurchase programs.

value.description: Reference to prior year charges associated with the closing of Microsoft Store physical locations, which reduced current-year operating expense comparisons.

events.quote: Operating expenses decreased $752 million or 6% driven by prior year charges associated with the closing of our Microsoft Store physical locations and reductions in retail store expenses and marketing, offset in part by investments in Gaming.

value.description: In connection with her appointment as Chief Accounting Officer, Alice L. Jolla will receive a stock award of $1.5 million under the Microsoft Corporation 2017 Stock Plan, vesting 6.25% every quarter subject to continuous employment.

events.quote: In connection with her appointment as Chief Accounting Officer, Ms. Jolla will receive a stock award of $1.5 million under the Microsoft Corporation 2017 Stock Plan, which will vest 6.25% every quarter, provided Ms. Jolla remains continuously employed.

value.description: Microsoft held its 2020 Annual Shareholders Meeting on December 2, 2020; shareholders elected all twelve director nominees, approved named executive officer compensation on an advisory basis, ratified Deloitte & Touche LLP as independent auditor for fiscal year 2021, and rejected a shareholder proposal concerning a report on employee representation on the Board.

events.quote: On December 2, 2020, Microsoft Corporation (the “Company”) held its 2020 Annual Shareholders Meeting (the “Annual Meeting”). There were 7,562,826,058 shares of common stock entitled to be voted at the Annual Meeting, of which 6,566,836,176 were voted in person or by proxy.

value.description: Shareholders rejected a shareholder proposal concerning a report on employee representation on the Board of Directors, with 5.15% votes for.

events.quote: (4) Rejected a shareholder proposal concerning a report on employee representation on the Board of Directors.

value.why_notable: The recurring self-description/mission statement — the anchor phrasing to compare year over year.

notable_language.quote: Microsoft is a technology company whose mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We strive to create local opportunity, growth, and impact in every country around the world.

value.why_notable: Frames the pandemic as a net demand tailwind rather than a disruption — a shift in characterization from the prior year's emphasis on uncertainty.

notable_language.quote: In fiscal year 2021, the COVID-19 pandemic continued to impact our business operations and financial results. Cloud usage and demand benefited as customers accelerate their digital transformation priorities.

value.why_notable: Unusually direct admission of a specific weakness (transactional licensing) alongside the benefits.

notable_language.quote: We saw improvement in customer advertising spend and savings in operating expenses related to COVID-19, but experienced weakness in transactional licensing.

value.why_notable: Explicit hedge immediately following the benefit narrative — the company declines to project the direction of continued pandemic effects.

notable_language.quote: The COVID-19 pandemic may continue to impact our business operations and financial operating results, and there is uncertainty in the nature and degree of its continued effects over time.

value.why_notable: A direct, recurring admission that investment spending may compress margins.

notable_language.quote: The investments we are making in infrastructure and devices will continue to increase our operating costs and may decrease our operating margins.

value.why_notable: Talent dependency stated as a stand-alone risk in MD&A rather than only in risk factors.

notable_language.quote: Our success is highly dependent on our ability to attract and retain qualified employees.

value.why_notable: Forward-looking commitment to rising capex — a signal of sustained cloud buildout.

notable_language.quote: We expect capital expenditures to increase in coming years to support growth in our cloud offerings.

value.why_notable: Concedes that, absent the useful-life accounting change, consolidated gross margin percentage actually declined.

notable_language.quote: Excluding this impact, gross margin percentage decreased slightly driven by gross margin percentage reduction in More Personal Computing.

value.why_notable: Explicit rationale for the metrics disclosure framework, framing metric selection as tracking 'our ambitions.'

notable_language.quote: We disclose metrics to enable investors to evaluate progress against our ambitions, provide transparency into performance trends, and reflect the continued evolution of our products and services.

value.why_notable: Standing caveat about the revenue-recognition consequence of the cloud transition, phrased conditionally despite the shift already being evident in results.

notable_language.quote: If our customers choose to license cloud-based versions of our products and services rather than licensing transaction-based products and services, the associated revenue will shift from being recognized at the time of the transaction to being recognized over the subscription period or upon consumption, as applicable.

value.why_notable: Committee attributes the FY21 design changes directly to shareholder pressure for more formulaic pay and better disclosure — the stated cause of the metric reweighting.

notable_language.quote: Shareholders generally encouraged the Board to increase the proportion of compensation that is tied to pre-established metrics and to enhance disclosures of the process used to determine incentive compensation results.

value.why_notable: Explicit description of the two structural shifts in CEO pay: majority-performance equity and, for the first time, downside TSR exposure rather than upside-only.

notable_language.quote:
• Increased the performance stock award portion of our CEO’s equity awards from 50% to 70% for fiscal year 2021
• Revised the relative TSR modifier for fiscal year 2021 PSAs to include a downside adjustment on PSA payouts if relative TSR falls below the 40th percentile of the S&P 500

value.why_notable: The only stated rationale for the PSA metric reweighting — Teams doubled from 10% to 20% while Xbox Game Pass, Surface and LinkedIn each fell, tying pay directly to the strategic narrative.

notable_language.quote: With the growing importance of Teams on our business strategy, we increased the weight for Teams Monthly Active Usage metric and redistributed weights for the other metrics in fiscal year 2021.

value.why_notable: A COVID-era change to the measurement period, framed as one-time and justified by market uncertainty — a structural softening that is not a discretionary award but does change how goals are measured.

notable_language.quote: For fiscal year 2021, we made a one-time decision to use semi-annual goals for the financial metrics used in both our cash incentive and performance stock award portions of our Executive Incentive Plan. This change was consistent with the goal-setting process used for our Company’s broad-based sales incentive programs and was made to mitigate some of the uncertainty in the marketplace.

value.why_notable: Pre-emptive defense listing the pandemic accommodations the committee declined to make, immediately after describing the one it did make.

notable_language.quote: We did not make other changes to our Executive Incentive Plan due to COVID-19, such as granting discretionary awards, shifting to more time-based awards, reducing target incentive opportunities, or adjusting previously granted awards.

value.why_notable: Targets are the internal operating budget rather than an independently calibrated stretch — a recurring rigor claim worth tracking year over year against the 200% financial payout actually delivered.

notable_language.quote: Our Compensation Committee sets cash incentive and PSA metric targets at the levels established, after review and engagement by the Board, for internal budgeting purposes. These targets are intended to be challenging but achievable.

value.why_notable: Language about maximum payouts requiring 'exceptional performance' sits against a FY21 financial result that paid the full 200% maximum on all four financial goals.

notable_language.quote: We set thresholds that we believe are reasonably achievable and maximums that we believe can be reached only with exceptional performance.

value.topic: Rationale for acquiring Nuance and Microsoft's industry-specific cloud strategy
value.stated_position: Microsoft frames the deal as "the latest step in Microsoft's industry-specific cloud strategy," accelerating efforts "to provide industry-specific cloud offerings to support customers and partners as they respond to disruption and new opportunities," building on the Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare introduced in 2020.

investor_qa.quote: Microsoft has accelerated its efforts to provide industry-specific cloud offerings to support customers and partners as they respond to disruption and new opportunities. These efforts include the Microsoft Cloud for Healthcare , introduced in 2020, which aims to address the comprehensive needs of the rapidly transforming and growing healthcare industry. Today’s acquisition announcement represents the latest step in Microsoft’s industry-specific cloud strategy.

value.topic: AI as a company-level priority and healthcare as its application
value.stated_position: Satya Nadella: "AI is technology's most important priority, and healthcare is its most urgent application," with the aim of putting "advanced AI solutions into the hands of professionals everywhere" alongside the partner ecosystem.

value.topic: Capital allocation — impact on share repurchases and EPS
value.stated_position: Microsoft expects the acquisition "to be minimally dilutive (less than 1 percent) in fiscal year 2022 and to be accretive in fiscal year 2023 to non-GAAP earnings per share," and states it "will not impact the completion of its existing share repurchase authorization."

investor_qa.quote: Microsoft expects the acquisition to be minimally dilutive (less than 1 percent) in fiscal year 2022 and to be accretive in fiscal year 2023 to non-GAAP earnings per share, based on the expected close timeframe. Non-GAAP excludes expected impact of purchase accounting adjustments, as well as integration and transaction-related expenses. The acquisition will not impact the completion of its existing share repurchase authorization.

value.topic: Governance and management of Nuance post-close, and segment reporting
value.stated_position: "Mark Benjamin will remain CEO of Nuance, reporting to Scott Guthrie, executive vice president of Cloud & AI at Microsoft," and "Upon closing, Microsoft expects Nuance's financials to be reported as part of Microsoft's Intelligent Cloud segment."

value.topic: Deal terms, approvals and closing conditions
value.stated_position: $56.00 per share, "implying a 23% premium to the closing price of Nuance on Friday, April 9, in an all-cash transaction valued at $19.7 billion, inclusive of Nuance's net debt"; unanimously approved by both boards and subject to Nuance shareholder and regulatory approvals.

investor_qa.quote: The transaction has been unanimously approved by the Boards of Directors of both Nuance and Microsoft. The deal is intended to close by the end of this calendar year and is subject to approval by Nuance’s shareholders, the satisfaction of certain regulatory approvals, and other customary closing conditions.

segments_basis.basis: reportable segments as named by the filing

investor_qa_basis.basis: management's written answers to questions submitted by investors, published roughly monthly. Same verification as every other fact — whole-document boundaries and a checked quote — but a different kind of evidence from a 10-K or proxy statement: unaudited, unprompted by any disclosure requirement, and responsive to whatever was asked. Corroborating; not a substitute for a filed disclosure.

ids.basis: content hash of the claim, its evidence and its source — see `fact_id` in src/equity_research/ledger_schema.py. Confidence and the verification result are NOT hashed, so re-verifying a fact does not renumber it. Cross-year uniqueness is enforced fatally at build time by `audit_ids`.

document_window.basis: filing dates of the documents this year's facts are actually drawn from — NOT the fiscal window in inventory.json, which bounds the fiscal years in scope. Documents reporting on a fiscal year are filed after it ends, so this range extends past window_end_date by construction. Any accession listed above additionally belongs to a fiscal year outside the window and is used deliberately: an annual-meeting vote held in May of year N decides on year N-1.

corrections.basis: config/corrections.toml — human corrections to model-extracted values that the cited filing contradicts, each carrying the filing text that establishes it. data/ledger/facts/ is never edited: the record of what the model returned has to stay as it was.
